Promise chaining and error propagation

Every then/catch call returns a new promise. Returning a value fulfills the next link; returning a promise
adopts its outcome; throwing rejects the next link. A catch can recover by returning a value.
then() එJක් return කළ value එක ඊළඟ then() එකට යනවා. Promise එකක් return කJළාත් ඒක settle Jවනකම් chain එක බලාJගෙන ඉන්නවා. throw කළ error එක catch() එකට යනවා.

Interview question: Why must you return a promise inside then?
Answer: So the next link waits for its outcome instead of proceeding with undefined.
Remember: Return to chain; throw to reject.
